ModMetadata.Name: Render Distance
ModMetadata.Author: Admin
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Render Distance[/h1]
Client-only. Buildings and fire/particle effects stay visible farther away.
[h2]Requires[/h2] [list] [*]BepInEx 5.4 [*]StationeersLaunchPad: [url]https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad[/url] [/list] Do not install on Dedicated Server.
[h2]In-game menu[/h2] Press [b]F10[/b] while in the world (hotkey is configurable) for sliders and which objects are affected.
[h2]Config[/h2] Stationeers/BepInEx/config/se.admin.RenderDistance.cfg
[h2]Source[/h2] GitHub: [url]https://github.com/REPLACE_GITHUB_OWNER/stationeers-render-distance[/url]
Many distant fires is expensive. Lower particle range if FPS drops.
